I'm holding my $1,170 so I can buy Ventnor or Marvin Gardens if I land on them, since either would go toward the yellows with my Atlantic Avenue. My public message warns the table about gemini's three hotels.

Trying another angle with p2 over Virginia doesn't seem worth pursuing either, and trading away Atlantic wouldn't help me since I already own it and want to keep targeting Ventnor and Marvin Gardens for the yellow set. I think the best move is just to hold my cash and end the turn.
